title: The credential-ownership bundle closes ~/.ticfacrc, so the operator cannot choose it as the local home for the classifier key
body: Finding c6f918cc offered three homes for the TypeSafe key: env var, ~/.ticfacrc key, or factory secret. x0k shipped the env var ($TICFAC_JEV_API_KEY) and the factory secret (TYPESAFE_API_KEY), but contracts/credential-ownership.json's schema is closed (additionalProperties: false) and internal/factory/credentials/contract_test.go asserts its keys equal the Go constants exactly — so a factory_jev_api_key in ~/.ticfacrc needs a pinned bundle change plus a matching Go constant, mirror and Worker-secret push (the pattern factory_github_token established). Propose the bundle grow factory_jev_api_key (credential_type classifier, secret, stored_in ~/.ticfacrc and worker secret TYPESAFE_API_KEY) if the operator wants the rc-file home.
